Logic Analysis: Contains Flask app instance, TodoList instance, and route handlers for adding, deleting, completing, and retrieving tasks.
Handles client-side logic for interacting with the API endpoints, updating the UI, and managing local storage.
Defines the HTML structure for the todo list application.
Contains CSS styles for the todo list application.
Full API spec:
openapi: 3.0.0
info:
  title: Todo List API
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /add_task:
    post:
      summary: Add a new task
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                text:
                  type: string
                  description: The text of the new task
              required:
                - text
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Successful operation
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    id:
                      type: string
                      description: The unique ID of the task
                    text:
                      type: string
                      description: The text of the task
                    completed:
                      type: boolean
                      description: Whether the task is completed
  /delete_task/{id}:
    post:
      summary: Delete a task
      parameters:
        - in: path
          name: id
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
          description: The ID of the task to delete
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Successful operation
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    id:
                      type: string
                      description: The unique ID of the task
                    text:
                      type: string
                      description: The text of the task
                    completed:
                      type: boolean
                      description: Whether the task is completed
  /complete_task/{id}:
    post:
      summary: Mark a task as complete
      parameters:
        - in: path
          name: id
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
          description: The ID of the task to complete
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Successful operation
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    id:
                      type: string
                      description: The unique ID of the task
                    text:
                      type: string
                      description: The text of the task
                    completed:
                      type: boolean
                      description: Whether the task is completed
  /get_tasks:
    get:
      summary: Get all tasks
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Successful operation
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    id:
                      type: string
                      description: The unique ID of the task
                    text:
                      type: string
                      description: The text of the task
                    completed:
                      type: boolean
                      description: Whether the task is completed
Shared Knowledge: The TodoList class manages the list of TodoItem objects. The localStorage API is used for persisting data in the browser. The UI is updated dynamically using JavaScript after each API call.
